Sigma Loop

Guardrails and an overnight autopilot for your AI coding agent. It makes the agent plan before it codes, has every plan reviewed before any edit, and can work through a whole backlog unattended, with each goal finished, verified and recorded.

Honest status. The full workflow is validated on Claude Code. Codex is partly validated, and Cursor and Antigravity are experimental. See Hosts for what was measured on each and what was not.

Who it is for

You areWhat you get
A developer who prompts an AI agent every dayEvery non-trivial change goes through the same steps, without you having to ask for them.
A team lead with a backlogQueue goals as GitHub issues or local files. The loop works through them and sets aside anything that needs a person.
Someone who wants an audit trailEach phase is recorded on the issue or in a local journal, so you can see what was decided and what was checked.

Start in three steps

  1. Install the plugin for your host

    One or two commands. Pick your host in the picker below.

  2. Run /sigma-init in your repository

    It checks access, asks where your backlog lives and which command runs your tests, and scaffolds the .sdlc folder. Safe to re-run.

  3. Run a goal

    /sigma-goal works one goal with you approving each phase. /sigma-loop works the backlog on its own.

The loop

Work moves along one chain. The front half is optional and turns a raw idea into scoped goals. Between the backlog and the build cycle sits a gate that, when switched on, stops a goal without a confirmed design from being worked at all.

The design gate is off by default. When it is on, a goal without a confirmed design is not worked: it is set aside and a design ticket is filed. Full detail

What it does

Plans are reviewed before any edit

An adversarial review checks the plan against the real code before anything is written.

Done is checked, not claimed

The loop will not mark a goal done until the action log shows every phase ran and both reviews approved.

It parks instead of guessing

Anything that needs a human decision is set aside with a reason, and the run continues.

It leaves an audit trail

Every phase is recorded on the issue or in a local journal.

Some of these rules are checked by code and some are instructions to the agent. Trust and limits says which.
